nodes.name: ui-upgrade
nodes.summary: Multi-phase UI upgrade plan for the voxlblade app — covers modal extraction, toast system, CSS consolidation, responsive improvements, accessibility, and build comparison.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Configuration file listing file patterns to exclude from the understand-anything analysis tool (intermediate artifacts, test files, etc.).

nodes.name: analyze-mounticon
nodes.summary: One-off debug script that reads MountIcon.svelte and extracts/displays its SVG path data length and content.

nodes.name: decode_full
nodes.summary: Standalone build decoder/debugging tool that reconstructs full character stats from equipment, enchantments, infusions, shrine, and perks using the same formulas as the main engine.

nodes.name: ONBOARDING
nodes.summary: Comprehensive onboarding guide documenting project architecture across 9 layers (config, source root, data, library, constants, engine, modals, statistics, stores), key concepts, guided tour, and complexity hotspots.

nodes.name: app.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS file defining all design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, shadows, z-index, transitions, durations), base resets, scrollbar styling, and utility classes for weapon art boxes and wild bolt UI.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root application component (~4300 lines) orchestrating the entire UI: equipment grid with drag-and-drop, all modal selection interfaces (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon blade/handle, infusion), enchantment management, tab navigation between Overview and Analyze views, stat display, and integration with the damage calculation engine.

nodes.name: BaseDamageCalc
nodes.summary: Core damage calculation display component (~2650 lines) computing per-hit typed damage with armor penetration, debuff multipliers, boost stacking, defense reduction, DoT ticks, curse rip, lifesteal, and heal calculations. Renders detailed damage breakdowns with tooltips.

nodes.name: BuffList
nodes.summary: Buff/debuff management component (~750 lines) aggregating active buffs from items, perks, weapon arts, potions, draconic infusion, true balance, and auto-debuffs. Groups, sorts, and displays buffs/debuffs/neutral effects with potency, duration, and source information.

nodes.name: BuildSaves
nodes.summary: Build save/load management component (~1100 lines) providing localStorage-based save slots with rename, drag-to-reorder, export/import (compressed base64), duplicate detection, fuzzy search across saved builds, and touch/mouse drag support.

nodes.name: CdrStepsCalc
nodes.summary: Visual cooldown reduction step calculator showing sequential CDR application (multiplicative or divisive) with floor rounding and minimum cooldown cap.

nodes.name: CritIcon
nodes.summary: Simple SVG icon component rendering a critical hit symbol with a red-to-orange gradient.

nodes.name: DamageAnalyzer
nodes.summary: The main damage analysis interface (~7000 lines), the heart of the application. Computes full damage pipeline including weapon hits, buff interactions, defense, crits, DoTs, self-damage, draconic bonuses, heals, and summons. Renders comprehensive damage breakdown UI with interactive debuff/buff toggling and enemy HP simulation.

nodes.name: draconicRunes
nodes.summary: Draconic rune and dragon infusion bonus calculation functions — applies color-based damage type bonuses from draconic rune stacks and dragon infusion buff potency.

nodes.name: applyDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Applies both draconic runes and dragon infusion bonuses to a damage types record.

nodes.name: getDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Returns combined draconic runes and dragon infusion bonus record without modifying input.

nodes.name: selfDamagePerks
nodes.summary: Defines self-damage perk definitions (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier) and a calculator function that computes self-damage with DR scaling, multi-target harmonic falloff, and per-type defense multipliers.

nodes.name: calcSelfDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates self-damage from a perk definition with DR, multi-target falloff, and defense multipliers.

nodes.name: stanceOverlays
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon stance overlays (Blaster Ring, Locked And Loaded, Cosmic Ray, Mine) based on context like fist/weapon type, blaster count, and weapon perks.

nodes.name: resolveStanceOverlay
nodes.summary: Returns the first matching stance overlay result based on weapon context conditions.

nodes.name: DidYouMean
nodes.summary: Search suggestion component displaying 'Did you mean?' chips when no exact search results are found, with highlighted text matching and perk-type differentiation.

nodes.name: DmgTotalTooltip
nodes.summary: Damage total tooltip component showing a pie chart of damage type distribution with per-type breakdowns, percentages, and badge labels for a computed hit.

nodes.name: DraconicAbilityStats
nodes.summary: Display component for draconic ability stats: damage type, scaling, poise damage, and optional holy/water healing values.

nodes.name: EmotionalTracker
nodes.summary: Interactive slider component for selecting emotional state (debuff/both/buff) with color-coded buttons, segmented track visualization, and build store integration.

nodes.name: Highlight
nodes.summary: Simple text highlighting component that wraps matching substrings with a highlight mark element.

nodes.name: LevelBar
nodes.summary: Interactive level and HP bar component with inline level editing, draggable HP fill, shield overlay, damage threshold line, and protection display.

nodes.name: AppHeader
nodes.summary: Application header component with title, animated tab switcher (Overview/Analyze), tab bubble transition, keyboard tab-switching shortcut, and integrated BuildSaves panel.

nodes.name: boosts
nodes.summary: Boost constant definitions for the damage system — multiplier-per-stack values for 30+ perks (Blood Thirsty, Venom Spitter, Golden Crits, etc.) plus complex boost internals (Heat Drill, Essence Ray, Spirit Winds).

nodes.name: cdr
nodes.summary: Cooldown reduction constant definitions for CDR-related perks (Caster, Channeled Weapon, Mage Rage, Poison Acceleration, Whirlwind, etc.).
